name: BuildingProgress
intent: A building elevation progress stack: one row per floor (top → bottom) with a completion bar and percentage, tapering wider toward the base like a building silhouette. The `activeId` floor is highlighted; pass `onFloorSelect` to make the rows interactive.
stubPlan: dataContract: stub — author input fields, slots, rowIdentity
configSchema: stub — enumerate config props from source

lineage.authoredBy: Group C of the missing-widgets template review (2026-08-26)
lineage.confidence: unset — intent taken verbatim from the module's own doc comment; contract not yet enumerated
notes: Was exported from @corensystem/coren-ui with no manifest at all, so it did not exist to the builder, to library-index.json, or to any agent selecting components.
Stub by design: the intent is accurate, the data contract is not yet authored.

usage: Use BuildingProgress to enhance your user interface. This component provides a consistent, accessible, and well-designed solution for this use case.
BuildingProgress integrates seamlessly with other components in the design system. Follow the established patterns and guidelines to ensure consistency across your application.

props.name: floors
props.description: Floors ordered top → bottom (roof first, base last), mirroring the building elevation.

props.name: activeId
props.description: Id of the highlighted (currently viewed) floor.

props.name: taperStep
props.description: Pixels each floor widens toward the base, giving the tapered building silhouette. Default 24.

props.name: size
props.description: Density. `compact` shrinks the rows, bars and text. Default `default`.

props.name: ...props
props.description: All standard HTML attributes are supported.

bestPractices.title: Use semantic props
bestPractices.description: Use the component's built-in props rather than className overrides.

bestPractices.title: Don't override core styles
bestPractices.description: Avoid using className to override the component's fundamental styling.

bestPractices.title: Provide accessible labels
bestPractices.description: Include proper ARIA labels for screen reader users.

bestPractices.title: Don't skip accessibility
bestPractices.description: Never omit accessibility attributes for interactive components.

bestPractices.title: Handle all states
bestPractices.description: Account for loading, error, empty, and success states.

bestPractices.title: Don't ignore edge cases
bestPractices.description: Avoid showing broken UI when data is missing or loading.
